qa_pairs.question: What is the amperage rating of fuse 20 in the power distribution box?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuse 20 is rated at 30 AMP according to the power distribution box diagram.

qa_pairs.question: What happens when the safety switch operates in the blower resistors?
qa_pairs.answer: The safety switch opens when resistors overheat according to the blower resistors diagram.

qa_pairs.question: What voltage level is supplied to the control switches section?
qa_pairs.answer: 1.5 VL (1.5 volts) is supplied to the control switches section.

qa_pairs.question: Which relay provides hot power only when running from the unloader?
qa_pairs.answer: Relay K7 provides hot power only when running from the unloader according to the note at the top.

qa_pairs.question: What are the resistance values for R2 and R3 in the blower resistors?
qa_pairs.answer: R2 has a resistance of 8 OHMS and R3 has a resistance of 35 OHMS in the blower resistors.

qa_pairs.question: What wire color coding is used for the dash lights connection?
qa_pairs.answer: The dash lights use .5 BR/WT (0.5 brown/white) wire color coding.
